author: Desmond
description: Strip all roles when a BAN role is applied, and run the Verify flow to restore standard roles when it is removed.
install_msg: Thank you for installing BanStrip. Get started with `[p]banstripset role <role>` and `[p]banstripset toggle true`.
name: BanStrip
short: Strip roles on BAN role, restore via Verify
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any End User Data
